name: Hatch Contour
author: Erin Carter
description: A Hatch variation: the whole crosshatch lattice is domain-warped along the drifting ghost field, so every burin stroke bends and flows around the hidden form like the curved lines of a wood engraving or a topographic map. Line curvature and tonal density agree, so the strokes wrap the volume and read as rounded relief rather than a flat screen.

params.label: Drift
params.effect: Speed of the invisible plume's drift through the hatching; 0 holds a frozen still-life of curved shading, 2 sends the ghost form billowing visibly across the frame.

params.label: Hatch gap
params.effect: Distance between hatch lines in CSS pixels — dense plate-engraving texture at the minimum, open sketchy strokes at the maximum.

params.label: Ink
params.effect: How strongly the ghost field modulates line weight; low yields near-uniform faint hatching, high carves deep chiaroscuro with bare paper-dark highlights and heavy black masses.

params.label: Bend
params.effect: How far the strokes bend along the flow; 0 collapses back to straight Hatch diagonals, high values curl the lattice into deep wood-engraving contours that wrap the form.
